name: Harmonic
description: Search, enrich, and research startups and companies using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Harmonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Harmonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.harmonic.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Harmonic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Harmonic lists 23 MCP tools, including enrich_company, enrich_person, get_saved_search_companies_results, get_saved_search_companies_net_new, get_saved_search_people_results, get_saved_search_people_net_new, get_saved_search_investors_results, get_saved_search_investors_net_new, search_companies_natural_language, typeahead_company_name, get_company_user_connections, and list_people_in_team_network.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Harmonic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Harmonic in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Harmonic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Harmonic is developed by Harmonic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
